address: 34-35 Southampton Street, Covent Garden, London, WC2E 7HG, United Kingdom
bio: Adam Handling's flagship is a restaurant that keeps up with the times: it’s fun, well-run and offers a friendly, rather uplifting atmosphere. The room's fresh, clean look keeps the focus firmly on the food, which is founded on classical techniques but blends in playfulness and originality to produce colourful, well-crafted dishes which are beautiful to behold. The signature bread served with chicken skin butter and liver pâté is inspired by Adam's sister, who would only eat roast chicken for Sunday lunch. The menu comes in the form of a map of Britain, showing where the ingredients come from....
